mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate of 0.34% (as observed) is a signal for positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as low interest rates compress discount rates and increase equity valuations.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% in a 3-month window signals economic weakness, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE is above 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 238.0) indicates a stable economic environment, causing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when both FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and CPIAUCSL < 238.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS rising above 0.5% over a 3-month period), the S&P 500 produces negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced liquidity and increased risk aversion.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises above 0.5% in a 3-month window
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises above 0.5% in a 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1100.0 in a 3-month window signals weak consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when HOUST is below 1100.0.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in industrial production above 105.0 in a 3-month window indicates strong economic activity, causing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO is above 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in retail sales (RSAFS) above 450000.0 (in millions of dollars) in a 3-month window signals strong consumer spending, causing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when RSAFS is above 450000.0.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 140000.0 (in thousands of persons) in a 3-month window signals a strong labor market, causing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when PAYEMS is above 140000.0.
